package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	pgadapter "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/verificationfixture"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const verificationFixtureTargetVolume = "learning-workspace-local_lw-course-db"

func runVerificationFixtureCommand(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if os.Getenv("LW_V0_COURSE_FIXTURE_TARGET_VOLUME") != verificationFixtureTargetVolume {
		return errors.New("V0_R3A_BLOCKED_TARGET_UNSAFE: required V0 Course volume guard is missing or mismatched")
	}
	var databaseName string
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&databaseName); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("V0_R3A_BLOCKED_TARGET_UNSAFE: cannot prove Course database name: %w", err)
	}
	if databaseName != "lw_course" {
		return fmt.Errorf("V0_R3A_BLOCKED_TARGET_UNSAFE: expected lw_course, connected to %q", databaseName)
	}

	definition, err := verificationfixture.LoadDefinition()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("load Course-owned fixture contract: %w", err)
	}
	courses := pgadapter.CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	modules := pgadapter.ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	sections := pgadapter.SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessons := pgadapter.LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	tasks := pgadapter.TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	contentAccess := pgadapter.ContentAccessRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	provisioner := verificationfixture.Provisioner{
		Definition: definition,
		Dependencies: verificationfixture.Dependencies{
			Tx:               pgadapter.TxManagerPG{Pool: pool},
			Courses:          courses,
			CourseI18n:       pgadapter.CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			CourseOutlines:   pgadapter.CourseOutlineRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			ContentAccess:    contentAccess,
			CourseReadAccess: contentAccess,
			I18n:             pgadapter.I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			CodeStructures:   pgadapter.CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Modules:          modules,
			ModuleI18n:       pgadapter.ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			CourseModules:    pgadapter.CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Sections:         sections,
			SectionI18n:      pgadapter.SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			ModuleSections:   pgadapter.ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Lessons:          lessons,
			LessonI18n:       pgadapter.LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			SectionLessons:   pgadapter.SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Tasks:            tasks,
			TaskI18n:         pgadapter.TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		},
	}
	result, err := provisioner.Ensure(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, verificationfixture.ErrDrift) {
			return fmt.Errorf("V0_R3A_BLOCKED_FIXTURE_DRIFT: %w", err)
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("V0_R3A_BLOCKED_PROVISIONING: %w", err)
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result)
}
